review_text: Groww deducted 1% brokerage when I withdrew my mutual fund money. Total fraud! Direct mutual funds are supposed to be zero commission. Refund my money!
Hidden charges on withdrawal! Took out 50000 rupees and got only 49500. Where did 500 rupees disappear? Groww customer care is giving standard automated replies.

Redeemed HDFC Small Cap after 6 months and observed 1% cut from total proceeds. Groww says it is AMC exit load, but why was this not displayed clearly on the redemption screen before submitting order?
Smooth SIP investments every month without glitch. Best app for mutual funds in India.
SIP installment debited from HDFC bank account on 5th August but Groww app status shows payment pending for 3 days. Unit allotment delayed and missed NAV opportunity.
Bank mandate auto-debit failed for my Nippon India SIP even though bank balance was sufficient. Now charged penalty by bank.
App crashes repeatedly every day at 9:15 AM when stock market opens. Cannot place stop loss orders during opening volatility.
Portfolio dashboard takes 15 seconds to sync holdings and sometimes shows zero balance. Very scary for active investors.
Raised ticket #89421 for double deduction on lumpsum order. Chatbot keeps looping with pre-written FAQ and closes ticket without human response.
Why does Groww take 1% commission on redeeming Parag Parikh flexi cap? You advertise zero commission direct mutual funds. Deceptive marketing!
Exit load fee explanation is completely hidden inside scheme docs. There should be a warning popup showing exact exit load deduction before confirming mutual fund sell order.
Re-KYC process is stuck in loop for 2 weeks. Uploaded Aadhaar and PAN card multiple times but status remains verification in progress. Cannot invest.
CAMS bank account verification failed without reason. Customer support takes 48 hours to reply with copy paste answers.
Love the clean interface and easy gold and mutual fund tracking. Best investment app.

Withdrew my mutual fund units after 11 months and saw exit load deduction. I thought after 1 year it is zero, but scheme exit period was 365 days. Show exact remaining days to avoid exit load on holding card!
Groww deducted 500 rupees unauthorized cut when redeeming my ELSS fund after 3 years. Misleading app!
Orders placed at 1:30 PM for mutual funds are allotted next day NAV instead of same day cut-off NAV. Fix payment gateway speed.
UPI Autopay mandate setup failed via Google Pay 4 times. Had to manually pay SIP installment.
Uninstalled after seeing 1% cut on my redemption amount. Groww secretly charges users during withdrawal.
Biometric fingerprint authentication fails frequently after latest update. Prompts for PIN every single time.
Customer support executive refused to explain why 1% was deducted from my mutual fund payout. Said 'check AMC rules' without any document link.
Candlestick charts on options chain freeze during high trading volume sessions. Lost money due to lag.
Exit load deduction of 1000 rupees on my ICICI Prudential fund redemption. Please give an exit load calculator widget on the portfolio tab so users know when exit load becomes zero percent.
Direct mutual fund investing is completely free and transparent. No complaints.
Redemption proceeds took 5 working days instead of T+2 days for liquid fund. Customer support had no clear answer.
Groww is charging exit fees on direct mutual funds and hiding it behind small fonts. Shifting portfolio to another broker.
Cannot change registered bank account. Mandate verification stuck on pending Penny drop for 7 days.
Helpdesk tickets are automatically marked 'Resolved' without resolving the actual issue. Worst support experience.
App crashed when placing market order in Nifty options. Forced logout and lost my position.
I redeemed units worth 1 lakh and received 99000 in bank. Groww deducted 1000 without upfront breakdown on withdrawal screen. Show the statutory AMC exit load breakdown before I confirm withdrawal!
Fast SIP processing and easy redemption directly to bank account. Excellent experience overall.
Groww took 1% commission on my mutual fund redemption. Zero commission claim is false. Will complain to SEBI.
Double payment debited for single mutual fund lumpsum order via UPI. Bank says money sent, Groww says order failed.
Push notifications for market alerts arrive 10 minutes late. Unusable for intraday traders.
Groww customer support number does not exist. Only AI chatbot that gives irrelevant answers and closes conversation.
Exit load deduction of 0.5% caught me off guard when switching mutual fund schemes. Please warn users in UI before confirming switch.
Nominee addition requires physical courier form. Why is there no digital Aadhaar e-sign for nominee update?
SIP cancelled automatically without any notification or SMS alert. Found out after 1 month.
Why does Groww cut 1% fee on mutual funds withdrawal? You claim to be a zero fee direct investment platform. Completely untrustworthy.
Great user interface for beginners. Tracking domestic and US stocks and mutual funds in one place.
Another 1% exit cut on my SBI Bluechip fund. Groww should clearly state on the redeem modal that AMC charges exit load, not Groww.
Penny drop failed for Axis Bank account addition. Waited 4 days and no status update.
Charts lag behind live NSE prices by 3 to 4 seconds during active trading hours. Bad for intraday.
Ticket #90112 regarding failed withdrawal has been open for 10 days without resolution. Automated bot repeats same line.
Groww deducted exit load without prior breakdown. Why do you hide this till after transaction is executed?
Direct plans save on expense ratios. Very easy to set up monthly automated SIPs.
Mutual fund NAV allotment delayed by 2 days. Market rose 2% and I got higher NAV price. Unfair execution delay.
Aadhaar OTP verification times out on the signature screen during account opening.
App freezes constantly on Android 14. Have to restart phone to see updated portfolio values.
Fraud broker! They took 1000 rupees cut on my mutual fund redemption claiming exit load. Groww is taking hidden cuts.
Please display AMC exit load applicability and countdown days right on the fund holding card.
Auto-pay debit happened twice for my monthly Kotak Emerging Equity SIP. Need refund for second debit.
No human agent on phone support. Chatbot keeps directing to useless FAQ articles.
Redeemed Mirae Asset Large Cap and got 1% less than displayed current value. Groww cheated me.
Watchlist sorting resets to default alphabetically whenever app is closed. Minor annoyance.
Re-KYC requirement was notified only after SIP was already paused. Lost one month compounding.
Best investment app for college students. Simple, zero hidden fees on investing, very transparent.
Why does Groww deduct money during withdrawal? You advertise zero commission direct mutual funds. Deceptive marketing!
Money deducted from bank via UPI but mutual fund order failed. Took 7 business days to get refund.
Mutual fund withdrawal screen must show a clear breakdown of AMC exit load vs broker fee zero. Otherwise users feel cheated.
